content.intro: Learn understanding middleware configuration through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines understanding middleware configuration as part of django project structure and configuration. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: The MIDDLEWARE setting; Middleware ordering; Request and response processing; Built-in middleware; Adding and removing middleware safely. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.

items.title: The MIDDLEWARE setting
items.text: Middleware hooks into request/response processing. Keep it focused, order it correctly, and ensure it returns a response when it short-circuits the request.

items.title: Middleware ordering
items.text: Middleware wraps request/response processing. Order matters because middleware can depend on state installed by earlier middleware or alter responses before they reach the browser.

items.title: Request and response processing
items.text: Request and response processing is part of the request/response contract. Match routes and methods explicitly, return an appropriate response/status, and test success, missing-resource and unauthorized paths.
